climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay, Syrah and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A geographical indication on the North Island, around New Zealand's largest city, covering the greater Auckland Region. Matakana, Kumeu and Waiheke Island lie inside it.
